description: Returns a player's actual stats for one season (2020 to now): fantasy points week by week and in total in the chosen scoring, plus the raw stat line and snap share each week. Use it for "how did X do" questions, game logs and comparisons with projections. Basic plan and above; a free key gets the last completed week only.

player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.
player_id.title: Player Id

scoring.description: Fantasy scoring: ppr (full PPR, the default), half (half-PPR) or standard.
scoring.title: Scoring

name: get_player_stats

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

note.description: A sentence for the user saying which plan is needed.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

season_points.description: Total fantasy points for the season.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

weekly_stats.description: Week -> that week's stat line, points and snap share (box score from 2025).

title: Player season stats
